summary: Dense and sparse switch statements (HTTP, calendar, TLV, PNG, UTF-8, HRESULT, errno, IP protocols, a toy ISA and a lexer automaton) that become jump tables, constant lookup tables, bit tests or compare chains depending on the optimisation level, with equivalence-preserving rewrites between switch, if-chain and table forms.

pairs.intent: Refactor-only release, no function changes behaviour: switches become if chains or lookup tables, a leap-year helper is extracted, case labels are reordered and parameters renamed. Every machine-code difference at any optimisation level is a false positive.
